subject: Leveling calibration: L4/L5/L6 offers & title guidance for candidate set
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:14:00-08:00
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Calibration request — Sam O'Neal (IC vs Manager track, L5/L6)

Thanks team — quick ask.

Sam O'Neal (interview loop last week) is ready for an offer. The interview panel split on leveling: two interviewers scored "strong L5" while one senior engineer pushed toward L6 given technical breadth. Recruiter Emma from Calibrate flagged candidate expectation of a senior IC title and wants guidance before we extend.

Attached: leveling_guideline_v3.pdf, sam_oneal_scorecard.pdf, comp_bands_Q1_2026.xlsx.

Key constraints:
- Headcount is approved at "Senior Engineer (L5)" for this req (HC-RE-137).
- Budget can support a competitive L5 package or limited L6 if leadership signs exception.

Ask: Can leadership/tech calibrate today on whether we extend as L5 (IC) with a pathway to promotion vs. push to L6 now? If L6, need approval for uplifted comp and headcount title change.

TL;DR: Recommend a quick sync (15m) today — otherwise Recruiting will prepare a standard L5 offer.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Recruiting Lead | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: leveling_guideline_v3.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:02:00-08:00
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Calibration request — Sam O'Neal (IC vs Manager track, L5/L6)

Priya — thanks for the summary and materials.

I'll review the scorecard and guideline this morning. My initial thought: if headcount is L5, we should not re-title to L6 without a formal exception. That exception should include a short business case (impact, expected ramp, cross-org needs) and a compensation delta.

Vivek — can you weigh in on the bar for L6 in infra/serving? Marcus, any immediate read from the loop?

If nobody objects, I prefer to extend as L5 with a clear growth plan and a 6-12 month promotion checkpoint — keeps comp predictable and aligns with HC approval.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering (Hiring Manager) | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T10:05:00-08:00
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Calibration request — Sam O'Neal (IC vs Manager track, L5/L6)

Agree with the conservative approach. Quick notes from the loop:

- Sam delivered very strong system design and performance tradeoff answers; signals for potential L6 scope.
- Gaps: ownership history over multiple quarters (we saw short tenures), limited cross-team program leadership in interviews.

Recommendation: Extend as L5 (IC) but structure the role to include a stretch impact area (e.g., rollout ownership for pruning/cache work). For promotion path, specify measurable milestones:
  - Deliver the pruning rollout (latency improvement + cost savings) within first 9 months
  - Lead a cross-team postmortem and architectural doc approved by tech leads

I've attached sam_oneal_scorecard.pdf with annotated rubrics. If leadership wants to make an exception to hire as L6, expect a ~15-20% uplift in total cash and an immediate equity band increase.

-Marcus
Senior Staff Engineer (acting) | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: sam_oneal_scorecard.pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T13:20:00-08:00
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Calibration request — Sam O'Neal (IC vs Manager track, L5/L6)

Team — thanks. A couple operational items:

1) Headcount approval: HC-RE-137 is approved for "Senior Engineer (L5)" in Q1. Changing title to L6 requires EPD lead sign-off + People Ops sign-off; that will take ~48 hours to get formal exception passed.

2) Budget: Comp bands file shows range: L5 base 150-190k, target equity 0.25-0.5%. L6 base 185-230k, equity 0.5-0.9%. If we want L6 now, we should confirm funding source (growth vs. bench) and capture in the headcount request.

3) Operational suggestion: Offer as L5 with a one-time sign-on to bridge expectation (we have precedent: $15k-$30k sign-on for near-L6 candidates). Include a written 12-month promotion plan and measurement checkpoints. This reduces procurement friction and preserves candidate momentum.

Linking headcount approval doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/people/headcount-approvals/2026-q1

Happy to sign the exception if Laura requests it after we get a short business case.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Engineering Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:32:00-08:00
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, emma@calibrate.co
Subject: Comp mechanics & draft numbers for Sam O'Neal (L5 offer)

Following Vivek's guidance, below are proposed offer numbers for L5 (target package, flexible):

- Base salary: $175,000
- Equity: 0.40% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (paid over first two pay cycles)
- Bonus: Eligible for annual bonus (~10% target)

If we wanted to make L6: approximate uplift to base $205k, equity 0.6%, sign-on optional.

Recruiting notes:
- Offer template (offer_template_redwood_L5.pdf) is ready to go.
- Emma (external recruiter) — please confirm candidate comp expectations align.

Please reply with APPROVE/ADJUST so Recruiting can extend by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Recruiting Lead | Redwood Inference
(Attachments: comp_bands_Q1_2026.xlsx, offer_template_redwood_L5.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T16:02:00-08:00
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, emma@calibrate.co
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Subject: Final decision: Extend L5 offer with promo pathway (Sam O'Neal)

I've reviewed the materials and input from the loop. Decision: extend a Senior Engineer (L5) IC offer with the following conditions:

Offer details (L5):
- Base: $175,000
- Equity: 0.40% (4y)
- Sign-on: $25,000
- Bonus: standard target

Conditions:
- Include a documented 12-month development plan with three measurable milestones (pruning rollout; cross-team doc; leadership of a performance initiative). Promotion to L6 may be considered at ~9–12 months upon successful completion + leadership sign-off.
- Offer letter must not represent current title as L6; promotion pathway language only.

Priya/Recruiting: please extend the offer to Sam and keep Emma looped. If the candidate counters for an immediate L6 title, escalate to me and Vivek — we will only approve L6 with a formal exception and uplifted comp.

Tessa/Marcus: please own the milestones and the 9-month checkpoint review.

Thanks all for the quick calibration — good outcome for the candidate and the org.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering (Hiring Manager) | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: offer_template_redwood_L5.pdf)
